context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page redesign is complete and fully functional. All sections render correctly with premium dark theme, gradient mesh backgrounds, glassmorphism effects, and colorful icons. Navigation works correctly. Mobile responsiveness is excellent. No issues found. The landing page uses CSS-only gradients and abstract shapes - no heavy images. Key data-testid attributes are in place for all interactive elements.

design_review.gradients: Gradient mesh backgrounds with multiple blur layers
design_review.glassmorphism: Backdrop-blur effects on cards and navbar
design_review.icons: Colorful gradient icons (blue, violet, amber, emerald, rose, slate)
design_review.typography: Manrope for headings, Inter for body text
design_review.colors: Brand colors: Gold (#e1b82c), Navy (#001f4b), accent gradients
design_review.responsiveness: Excellent mobile adaptation with proper stacking
